findings.problem: The verifier trusted probe_result pixel format/depth, so Bgr555 control could be certified as Bgr565 and the reverse.
findings.fix: Derive the expected source format/depth/storage independently from each known fixture (Bgr24/8/24, Bgra32/8/32, Bgr565/6/16, Bgr555/5/16), require probe_result and the admitted stage to match, and add both-direction negatives.
findings.negative: Bgr555→Bgr565 and Bgr565→Bgr555 both fail with source_format_mismatch.

findings.problem: Stop validation checked state/hold/kill/reap but not cause, method, kill_error, waited, request time monotonicity or worker-exit agreement.
findings.fix: Require cause=boundary_hold, method=direct_child_terminate_wait, kill_error=null, waited=true, requested/observed/started/exited monotonic agreement, non-zero exit and exit_after_request == worker exit_code.
findings.negative: Unattributable cause, never-issued method, missing request time and exit-code mismatch all fail with stop_not_confirmed.

native_refresh.reason: The verifier is part of the recorded Native source identity, so the real-WIC record was regenerated instead of edited.

evidence_repair: cancellation-record.json now retains both cancel_roi and timeout_roi, including cause, method, request/observation times and worker exit codes.
gate_and_review: Changed source requires a new pinned Gate pair and fresh Tern review; the round-one pair under review-round1-* is not transferred.
